answer.rationale: Current state: p99 latency 5x target in primary region only, heavy write traffic at settlement peak, security patch cannot be reverted. Rollback is eliminated by compliance constraint. Regional failover (memory_b2) successfully restored latency during March degradation with clean traffic shift and rapid error recovery—directly applicable to this primary-region-confined issue. Cannot add capacity (settlement peak leaves no headroom) or route replicas (read queries don't address write path). Circuit breakers don't resolve latency, only contain blast radius. Failover shifts settlement writes to healthy secondary region, preserves the mandatory security patch, and memory_b2 demonstrates this pattern works under peak load. Preserves uncertainty: if secondary is also degraded or if the latency root cause affects all regions, failover will reveal that before full blast radius.
